note: Original short lines written for TrackCal (not quotations). Rotated by date. Keep them optional, kind and free of guilt, numbers and body talk.
messages: Small steps still move you forward.
Today can be a light day. Light days count.
Water, a stretch, a breath: pick one.
Your pace is the right pace.
Rest is part of the plan, not a break from it.
One good meal is a good meal. That's enough.
A walk around the block is still a walk.
You don't have to finish everything to start something.
Check in with how you feel, then decide.
Yesterday is done. Today is open.
Curiosity beats pressure. Try something new.
Notice one thing you did well this week.
Some days are for showing up, some for slowing down.
Fuel, not fear. Eat what helps you feel steady.
Two minutes of movement is a real thing.
Plans can change. That's what plans are for.
Celebrate the habit, not the number.
Ask a friend to join you. Company helps.
Sleep is training too.
You can restart at any meal, any hour.
Be as kind to yourself as you'd be to a friend.
Pick the easiest version of today's goal.
A pause is not a stop.
Cook something simple you enjoy.
Stand up, roll your shoulders, carry on.
Try one new vegetable this week, just for fun.
Progress isn't a straight line. It still counts.
Your body did a lot today. Say thanks.
Fresh air is free. Take a little.
Choose what fits your day, not someone else's.
Little wins stack up quietly.
If today was hard, tomorrow is a new page.
Stretch before the screen, after the screen.
Your routine should work for you, not the other way round.
Music on, move a bit, see how it feels.
Taste your food. Slow is fine.
Showing up imperfectly still counts as showing up.
Plan one thing for tomorrow and let the rest be.
Laughing counts as a core workout. Probably.
Whatever you do today, do it your way.
